'''Corundum''' was a hard, crystalline [[mineral]] that had a red [[Color/Legends|color]]. Though it was commonly used for manufacturing purposes, pure corundum was also incorporated into jewelry.<ref name="GSWU" /> "Harder-than-corundum" was a common simile to refer to tough, stoic individuals such as [[Vega Sepen]].<ref name="EV">"[[Emissary of the Void]]"</ref>
